title: agent-comment-lint settings
description: The .agent-comment-lint.json file at a repository root. Settings can exclude paths and add governance references; they cannot relax a rule.

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, for editors. It is otherwise ignored.

exclude.description: Paths that are never checked, such as vendored or generated code.

path.description: A path relative to the repository root. * and ? match inside one directory, ** crosses directories, and a final / takes the whole tree.

reason.description: Why the path is not judged.

governance.description: Governance references to refuse in comments, on top of the always-on core.

pattern.description: A Python regular expression, searched in each comment's text. It must not match empty text.

reason.description: Why the pattern is a governance reference.
